research_metadata.scope: English-language Pokémon Trading Card Game printing
data_notes: Gameplay fields reproduce the referenced open card-data record.
Collector terminology is separately labeled and may differ from the dataset rarity name.
Market values are deliberately not frozen into this file because they change frequently.

attacks.name: Spiral Growth
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, search your discard pile for a basic Energy card and attach it to Rayquaza ex.

attacks.name: Dragon Burst
attacks.text: Discard either all Fire Energy or all Lightning Energy attached to Rayquaza ex. This attack does 40 damage times the amount of Fire or Lightning Energy discarded.

rules: When Pokémon-ex has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

grading_target.certification_status: Target grade profile only; not a specific certified slab.
grading_target.important_disclaimer: A grade cannot be assigned from this reference image. Verify the exact physical card and its certification record before buying.

collector_assessment.why_it_is_collectible: An early English Rayquaza Pokémon-ex from the EX era and a strong vintage Rayquaza centerpiece.
authentication_risks_and_checks: Compare the card against a known-authentic example: font, symbols, borders, colors, and card stock.
Inspect holofoil or texture under moving light; flat, printed-on shine is a major warning sign.
For a graded card, verify the certification number directly with the grading company and compare the slab image.
Check for trimming, rebacking, recoloring, pressed dents, filled whitening, or other restoration.
For high-value purchases, use an established seller, protected payment method, return rights, and third-party authentication.
storage_recommendations: Do not handle the card surface with bare fingers.
For raw cards: use a clean inner sleeve, rigid holder, and archival storage box.
For graded cards: use a slab sleeve and a fitted protective case.
Store upright in a stable, dry environment away from direct sunlight and rapid temperature changes.
Do not expose the card to cleaners, adhesive labels, PVC pages, or pressure from overfilled binders.

market_research.note: Use recent completed sales for the same language, exact card number, grading company, numeric grade, qualifier, and certification status. Asking prices are not equivalent to realized prices.
